content:
Maria Chen: Heads up — during the canary deploy we found raw debug logs containing user emails. Saw this at 13:02 UTC. Incident INC-2026-07-21. Snippet:
```json
{"ts":"2026-07-21T13:02:05Z","request_id":"abc123","user_email":"alice@example.com","payload":"..."}
```
sec-bot: Automated scan flagged possible PII in /var/log/redwood/serviceX/2026-07-21.log (low).
Jon Patel: Which environment? prod or staging? exact path?
Maria Chen: Prod canary. Path: s3://redwood-canary-logs-prod/canary/2026-07-21/serviceX.log.gz. Time window ~13:00-13:10 UTC.
Lia Gomez: I just revoked the canary role's S3 list/get permissions and rotated the instance keys for that fleet. Will check if snapshots contain objects.
Sam Rivera: tagging @legal — if emails are in S3 beyond retention we may need to notify. How many unique addresses?
Diana Ho: Quick grep on the prefix found ~12 objects with an "user_email" field. Commands I ran:
```bash
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-canary-logs-prod/canary/2026-07-21/
# then
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-canary-logs-prod/canary/2026-07-21/serviceX.log.gz /tmp/ && zcat /tmp/serviceX.log.gz | jq '.user_email' | head
```
I'll snapshot them to a secured bucket now and lock ACLs.
Jon Patel: Important: were these consumed by any downstream persistence (DB, analytics store)? or just ephemeral consumers?
Maria Chen: Downstream analytics lambda consumed the stream but it failed partway and didn't write to the main analytics DB. I verified no DB writes in the 13:00 window. Sanitized sample:```json
{"ts":"2026-07-21T13:02:05Z","request_id":"abc123","user_email":"[REDACTED]","payload":"..."}
```
Sam Rivera: Legal, what's your take? @Ethan Legal
Ethan Legal: Need: timeline, number of unique users, retention duration, whether data left AWS (eg. external IPs). If <100 users and only in logs, we usually do internal memo + monitoring; if more or exfiltrated, external notice may be required. DM me the snapshot and exact object list.
Lia Gomez: In progress: started job to copy objects -> s3://redwood-secure-incident-snapshots/INC-2026-07-21/, set lifecycle to delete after 24h pending legal. Created INFRA-3421 to document key rotation.
Diana Ho: Objects moved and ACL tightened. I also disabled public-read on the bucket and enabled server-side encryption for the snapshot.
Jon Patel: I'll draft a short internal comms blurb for engineering + support. Maria, can you confirm whether any customer-facing identifiers (customer_id, tenant) were present?
Maria Chen: Only email addresses in these particular lines; no tenant_id fields. All from a canary subset of traffic.
Sam Rivera: OK — next steps summary: 1) Diana -> secured snapshot & ACLs (done) 2) Lia -> rotate keys + revoke perms (in progress) 3) Jon -> draft internal comms for ENG/Support (WIP) 4) Ethan -> advise on external notice (waiting DM). Maria will open the incident doc and add the object list.
Maria Chen: Thanks — will update INC doc and ping when legal approves comms. :thumbsup:
